entities.summary: Vasil Kirkov is a Bulgarian-born American professional tennis player. He has a career high ATP doubles ranking of world No. 55 achieved on March 16, 2026 and a career high singles ranking of No. 439 achieved on November 22, 2021. He has reached one ATP doubles final. Kirkov has won 11 doubles ATP Challenger Tour titles, including 7 titles in 2025, tied for the second-most titles for that season.
